summary: Full backend + CLI + frontend testing of the bug-bounty automation toolkit. All 13 pytest cases pass (10 API + 3 CLI). End-to-end UI flow verified: brand, scan-form, authorization gating on Run Scan, module pills, scan execution, summary-stats counts, vuln findings (4 found for example.com), and multi-format report tab all working as specified.
critical_code_review_comments: bb_api.py uses asyncio.run(_persist(...)) inside a worker thread which spins up a new event loop per persistence call — acceptable for low volume, but consider a single shared loop or motor's run_in_executor pattern for higher throughput.
bb_api.JOBS is in-memory only; on backend restart, in-flight job progress is lost. Persisted-only scans (no progress) are still listable, which is fine. Document this in README.
bb_api._public_job returns counts via `(result or {}).get('vuln',{}).get('counts')` — when vuln module is not selected, counts will be None (not an issue, just noting).

/api/bb/scans/{job_id} returns the raw persisted doc (no _id, OK) when not in JOBS — schema differs slightly from _public_job (no 'progress' field, has 'result' key). Frontend appears to tolerate it but worth normalizing.
ScanRequest has no upper bound on `modules` list length or wordlist sizes — DoS surface if exposed publicly. Add max_length validators.
Authorization gating is correct (returns 400 without i_have_authorization) and CLI exits 2 without --i-have-authorization as designed.
test_credentials: Not applicable (no auth in this app)
seed_data_creation: Test scans created against target 'example.com' (safe public test domain). Scans are persisted in db.bb_scans; delete-scan test cleans up its own scan. Other test scans remain (visible in History panel) — main agent can clear db.bb_scans if desired.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend endpoints under /api/bb/* fully functional. Use target 'example.com' with modules=['scan','vuln'] and with_whois=false for fast (<20s) E2E tests. UI exposes exhaustive data-testid set (scan-form, input-target, input-authorization, module-pill-{recon,scan,vuln}, btn-launch, tab-{console,recon,scan,vuln,report}, summary-stats, stat-*, finding-*, report-pre, report-fmt-{txt,json,md}, report-download, history-item-{id}). Scan polling on UI completes ~10s for example.com.
rca of the issue: No bugs found — all specified behaviors pass.
